mechanism_narrative: A downward trend in the federal funds rate (measured as the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or the 20-day return distribution in these instances is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value above 215.5 signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 215.5, or the 20-day return distribution in these instances is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5) and declining employment (PAYEMS < 137640.0) signals a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.5 and PAYEMS < 137640.0, or the 20-day return distribution in these instances is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary regime (defined by UNRATE > 5.5 and negative GDP growth), the S&P 500 tends to produce negative returns over the next 20 trading days due to economic contraction.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.5 and GDPC1 growth rate < 0, or the 20-day return distribution in these instances is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A downward trend in industrial production (measured as the 3-month change in INDPRO) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 975.0 (thousands of units) signals weak demand for housing, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 975.0, or the 20-day return distribution in these instances is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
